client.business_model: Multi-state home health, hospice, rehabilitation and personal-care provider operating a network of in-home clinicians and branch offices across the Southwest and South-Central U.S.
client.sponsor_pe_firm: Trive Capital (majority) and Coltala Holdings (minority stake)
client.client_history: Founded in 2007 by physical therapist David Jackson as a rehabilitation practice, Choice Health at Home entered home-health services in 2012 and hospice in 2018. Backed by Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings since 2020-2021, the company has grown through acquisitions and now serves patients across seven states.

revenue.notes: No explicit revenue figure was found in company filings, press releases, or reputable databases.

locations.source: Company website locations pages (choicehealthathome.com/locations) enumerating 47 branch addresses across AZ, CO, KS, NV, OK, TX and UT
locations.notes: Counted individual branch locations listed on the official website (accessed Feb 2026). Hospicenews.com (Aug 2021) stated “over 40 locations,” which is consistent with the website tally.

employees.source: LinkedIn company page for Choice Health at Home (shows 1,001–5,000 employees, accessed Feb 2026)
employees.notes: LinkedIn lists the range 1,001–5,000 employees; Hospicenews.com (Aug 2021) cites “more than 800 clinicians.” Using a midpoint estimate (≈1,500 total employees) but treating as low confidence due to broad range and lack of precise disclosure.
